title: Aeroplane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff5f6d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3ec6ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#1f8cff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M25 42 L18 22 L33 40 Z' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- lower tail wing -->
  <path d='M26 60 L14 72 L34 62 Z' fill='#ffa726'/>
  <!-- main fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='52' rx='34' ry='13' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- top wing -->
  <path d='M50 44 L28 20 L40 20 L64 44 Z' fill='url(#wing)'/>
  <!-- lower wing -->
  <path d='M52 62 L36 84 L50 84 L68 62 Z' fill='#1f8cff'/>
  <!-- nose cone -->
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='52' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- cockpit windows -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='47' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#aeeaff'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='47' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#aeeaff'/>
  <!-- smiley eyes -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='55' r='3' fill='#12355b'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='3' fill='#12355b'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M61 60 Q67.5 66 74 60' fill='none' stroke='#12355b' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek glow -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='59' r='1.8' fill='#ff7b9c'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='59' r='1.8' fill='#ff7b9c'/>
  <!-- propeller -->
  <rect x='92' y='47' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <ellipse cx='96' cy='52' rx='3' ry='9' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
